notes.title: Steam Next Fest Stream
notes.content: Join us for an exciting live stream of It’s A Game Changer during Steam Next Fest! The developer, will showcase this unique rogue-like game that keeps you on your toes with a dynamic collection of microgames. Experience fast-paced gameplay as the game cycles through various mini-challenges, each offering a fresh twist. During the stream, you’ll get a behind-the-scenes look at the development process, and hear about inspirations.
